SyncProfile.title: SyncProfile
SyncProfile.description: Authenticated user's cloud sync profile and active device pointer.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

email.description: Optional owner email address isolated to owner reads.

activeDeviceId.description: Most recently synced local device identifier.

totalSnapshots.description: Non-negative count of synced device snapshots.

CloudDeviceSnapshot.title: CloudDeviceSnapshot
CloudDeviceSnapshot.description: Cloud-synced summary snapshot of a device's installed apps, events, and call log counts.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

deviceModel.description: Hardware device model string (1 to 80 characters).

appCount.description: Number of tracked applications in inventory.

activityCount.description: Number of recorded app install/update/uninstall events.

callLogCount.description: Number of synced call log metadata records.

unlockCount.description: Number of synced device unlock events.

syncStatus.description: Current cloud synchronization status for the device.

CloudActivityRecord.title: CloudActivityRecord
CloudActivityRecord.description: Individual cloud-synced app activity, inventory, call metadata, or unlock record.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

recordCategory.description: Category of the synced activity record.

title.description: Primary title such as app name or protected call label (1 to 120 chars).

subtitle.description: Package name or call classification (1 to 160 chars).

detail.description: Optional installer, version, or duration detail (up to 240 chars).

eventDate.description: Local date formatted yyyy-MM-dd (1 to 20 chars).

eventTime.description: Local time formatted HH:mm:ss (1 to 20 chars).

/users/{userId}.description: Private user sync profile containing active device metadata and optional owner email.

/users/{userId}/activity_records/{record.description: Per-user synced application activity and call metadata records.
